set.body:
Defect: The intake record left this open pending the upstream notebook. It does not need the notebook: WhichEvent is on a 56-event scale and FriendsMoreEMs IS that scale, sharing the Time axis with the 52-event FriendsNarrComb. Two independent proofs: WhichStoryline=='Interlude' and WhichEvent==37 both occur in exactly 67 rows; collapsing the 56-scale storylines agrees with the scorer on 98.97% of rows vs 52.72% on the 52-scale.

Do: Encode the piecewise map as a versioned, evidenced SegmentLink: 1..18 identity; 19 removed (interlude, t=722); 20..36 shift -1; 37 removed (interlude, t=1571); 38 shift -2; 39 removed/merged (t=1639); 40..47 shift -3; 48 removed/merged (t=2149); 49..56 shift -4.

Tests: TRAP: three events carry different Time values between the two sheets (146/147, 763/766, 2005/2007), so an exact-equality join silently drops them and yields a WRONG map. Join on (TimeOrig, Time +/-5s) or on (Explanation, SceneNum), and ASSERT a bijection of size 52.

Mutants (SD1 — each must die, recorded by name): join on exact Time equality -> the bijection-size assertion must fail.

Exit: The crosswalk is a tested contract with the storyboard as its own oracle. DECISION inside this bead: Friends em56 39 and 48 are 'REMOVED (merged...)' in the companion table -- decide Removed vs To(neighbour) FROM FriendsMoreEMs, do not assume.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md S3 'The event-scale crosswalk'
